Druid City Bicycle Club Tuesday Ride

Tuscaloosa, AL · Road

Druid City Bicycle Club Tuesday Ride is a road group ride in Tuscaloosa, AL. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 5:30 pm from Embassy Suites parking lot, downtown Tuscaloosa. Pace: starts together, then splits by distance and speed.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: starts together, then splits by distance and speed. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @druidcitybicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Druid City Bicycle Club Tuesday Ride group ride

The club's main weeknight ride. Everyone starts together, then splits by distance and speed. Thursday rides from the same lot head northwest toward Tuscaloosa County High School. Rides are members only, at $25 a year. Confirm the start on the club's Facebook, since a recent post mentions a 5:00 pm start from River District Park.
